goal: Repair the governed reviewer assignment parser so its current durable allowlist cursor can be read and independent review can resume, without accepting arbitrary cursor text or changing reviewer selection policy.
dispatcher: Codex session repairing the reviewer assignment blocker discovered while publishing Albert's shared-db workflow refactor plan (issue #3339)
prohibited_actions: do not change reviewer roster, rotation order, independence, lease or verdict policy
do not mutate database objects, migrations, repository settings or production
do not use an unvalidated cursor suffix or bypass governed review
assumptions: the live cursor suffix allowlist uses only reviewer identifiers separated by commas
the suffix is metadata for a cursor record and is not reviewer selection authority
stop_conditions: stop if accepting the suffix would permit arbitrary trailing cursor data
stop if current assignment needs a roster or policy change rather than parser compatibility
stop if tests show the active record cannot be represented by the bounded grammar
